data.description:
Confirm the ML hooks fix is working by verifying:

1. SessionStart hook shows ML banner at session start
2. New session entries appear in .git-ml/tracked/sessions.jsonl
3. Stats show increasing session count (> 186)
4. Test isolation still works (metrics.jsonl = 10 lines after tests)

Reference: KT-20260103-090434

properties.retrospective:
## What Worked
- Handoff instructions were clear and actionable
- Verification steps helped identify the real issue quickly
- Hook scripts were already in place and executable

## What Didn't Work
- Previous session claimed to fix hook config but changes were NOT persisted
- The ~/.claude/settings.json only contained the git-check Stop hook, not the ML hooks

## Root Cause
Previous agent likely displayed the configuration but didn't actually write it to the file, or the write failed silently. The configuration showed in KT-20260103-090434 but wasn't in the actual file.

## Fix Applied
Wrote complete hook configuration to ~/.claude/settings.json with:
- SessionStart hook (cwd:Opus-code-test matcher)
- PostToolUse hook (cwd:Opus-code-test matcher)
- Stop hook for ML capture (cwd:Opus-code-test matcher)
- Preserved existing git-check Stop hook

## Verification
- Manually ran ml-session-start-hook.sh: Works correctly
- JSON syntax validated
- Next session should see SessionStart hook fire automatically

data.title: Confirm ML hooks are capturing data
